item.text:
The audit is at a stable handoff with no new high-value captured-code finding in this round. I re-checked the remaining candidate areas and confirmed they are either already covered, blocked, or too speculative without an authoritative TLA/quorum reference.

Final evidence state:

- Critical result: the all-alive partitioned-leader divergence. Replica 0 retains the chosen PUT while replicas 1-4 commit NOOP; executing the instance leaves key 7 only on replica 0.
- Recovery root causes validated by separate diagnostic copies: local `PrepareReply.VBallot` (F1) and Commit ballot (F20). With both one-line fixes, the recovery-stall, fast-chosen, and slow-chosen cluster tests pass; 25 unrelated audit failures remain.
- 22 findings documented; the validation matrix maps each to its tests and outputs.
- Four cluster controls pass; 34 epaxos finding tests fail as intended; both client failover tests and the dlog nil-logger test fail.
- `go build ./...` passes; captured implementation files remain byte-identical to `../source`.

Remaining work is blocked or out of scope:

- Full master/replica/client startup is blocked by F16 (`defs.IP()` nil dereference) and the master's `ping` dependency.
- Durable mode is not selected by `run.go`; pipeline mode is disabled; non-EPaxos protocols are outside this variant.
- A randomized fault-injection campaign was not run; deterministic recovery/recoverer matrices and fixed-seed shuffled delivery are the evidence base.
